title: The Rainbow Swap

captures.note: real swap: 0.0005 ETH → 1.377901 USDC via Sprinter
dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Rainbow's built-in Swap, ETH→USDC. The quote comes from Rainbow's swap API (swap.p.rainbow.me/v1/quote), routed 100% through Sprinter, with a Rainbow fee of 0.00000425 ETH (0.85%). THE FINDING: the swap went out as a type-4 (EIP-7702) transaction — a self-call carrying an authorization that delegates the account's code to 0x612373d7…51d3, verified on Sourcify as CaliburEntry (Calibur, Uniswap's 7702 smart-account contract). The fee line read 'Est. Smart Wallet Fee … Includes smart wallet activation'; the account was never asked in plain words. After this tx the address has code (0xef0100612373…): every later transaction from it, in any wallet, runs through that contract. Before quoting, Rainbow checked platform.p.rainbow.me/v1/wallets/delegation/WalletStatus and NetworkStatus. Same RPC as RB1 (rpc.rainbow.me). Real mainnet tx 0xa030ca7316455109ad2205f80c11bca9b40f95cbedb3c8711616412beec529f2.
